<h2>Extract a Model Tuning Integer</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Extracts one integer value from a one-row model tuning table.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>extract_model_tuning_integer(
  data_tuning_row,
  column_name,
  scale_id,
  required = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_tuning_row">data_tuning_row</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row data frame containing model tuning values.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="column_name">column_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single character string naming the value to extract.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="scale_id">scale_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single character string used in validation messages.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="required">required</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical indicating whether a missing value should raise an error.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A single integer, or 'NULL' for an optional missing value.
</p>

</main>
